checkedAlternates.risk: Biathlon and Nordic Combined both include cross-country skiing.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Biathlon pairs cross-country with rifle marksmanship (group-1), whereas Nordic Combined pairs it with ski jumping (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Moguls is timed down a steep slope.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Moguls is a judged freestyle event with bumps and aerial jumps (group-3), not gated alpine racing (group-4).
